_comment: Non-resident tax rates read off PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, 31/08/2026, and merged over the workbook's figures by build_data.py. The rate recorded is the one that applies to THIS page's case: an individual non-resident who holds a residential property for ten years and then sells. That is not the headline rate. Several countries exempt the gain entirely once a property has been held five years, which the workbook's rates missed completely.
_basis: rent: net | gross | deemed | schedule | exempt. cgt: gain | proceeds | deemed | schedule | exempt | none. Only net/gross/exempt (rent) and gain/exempt/none (cgt) are used in the arithmetic; the rest are shown as text.

rent.note: 5% PIT on residential rental income, net of related deductions
rent.quote: Personal income tax (PIT) at 5% is applicable to the rental income derived by an individual as a result of renting out residential space

cgt.note: 5% on the profit
cgt.quote: The profit received from sale of a vehicle and an apartment (house) with attached land plot is subject to tax at a 5% rate.

rent.note: 25% on residential rentals
rent.quote: In general, rental income from residential rentals is taxed at 25%.

cgt.quote: This income is taxed at the marginal rates varying between 12.50% and 48%

cgt.quote: The transfer of ownership of real estate, either land or buildings, is subject to 15% tax on the capital gain realised from the sale transaction.

_coverage: All 34 markets read off PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, 31/08 and 02/09/2026. Where PwC does not state a single rate for a non-resident, the basis is 'schedule' and the arithmetic leaves it out rather than inventing one.
